evidence.detail: Decks view only has a league_only bool; no tournament_only support or three-way toggle
/people/ route has no deck_type parameter at all — no league/tournament filtering
Current toggle is binary (Tournaments Only on/off); no three-way all/league/tournament component exists
/decks/ validate_deck_type allows only [DeckType.ALL, DeckType.LEAGUE]; /decks/tournament/ would raise DoesNotExistException
/archetypes/ validate_deck_type allows only [DeckType.ALL, DeckType.TOURNAMENT]; /archetypes/league/ would raise DoesNotExistException

triage.notes: Substantial scope: needs a new React three-way toggle component, data-layer support for all missing combinations (tournament filter on decks, league filter on archetypes/cards/card), route validator updates, and people-page filter plumbing. Subsumes #6798.
